verdict.rationale: Cyril Amarchand Mangaldas is a law firm offering legal advisory services, not a software product with a UI and API, so API-versus-UI parity is a category error for this kind of product. Nothing in the evidence shows the firm ships a software product with an API that would make the axis apply; its AI use is internal legaltech for its own practice.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI
